phases.name: Local-first environment certification and production-safe promotion
phases.objective: Certify Local/Dev on development with dedicated Neon first, then Staging end-to-end, before any Production promotion.
exit_criteria: Local/Dev runs from development with a dedicated Neon database.
Dedicated Staging Shopify identity is verified.
Staging Worker, PostgreSQL and Queue/DLQ are healthy.
Staging Shopify auth/session/Admin API reads pass.
Exact unlimited USD 55 every 30 days with 5-day test trial contract is verified.
Production remains unmodified until Staging acceptance evidence exists.

work_units.title: Align repository management model with VSN Metafields
work_units.objective: Install repository-backed project state, role routing, coordination, risk, release, audit and governance registries.
acceptance_criteria: Issue #32 is the active work anchor.
AGENTS/manifest route Supervisor/Worker roles through repository state.

work_units.title: Set up and certify Local Dev with Neon
work_units.objective: Run VSN Stock Down Sort Dev from development using an isolated Neon PostgreSQL database before any Staging work.
blockers: Dedicated Neon project vsn-stock-down-sort-local still needs to be provisioned/bound and its project ID recorded.
acceptance_criteria: development is the Local integration branch.
npm run dev uses VSN Stock Down Sort Dev.
DATABASE_URL is a Neon pooled connection.
DIRECT_URL is the matching Neon direct connection.
Prisma migrations pass on the Local Neon database.
Local credentials do not reuse Staging or Production database identities.

work_units.title: Verify staging environment secret contract
work_units.objective: After Local certification, prove required cloudflare-staging GitHub Environment values are configured without exposing values.
blockers: Local/Dev Neon certification must complete first.
acceptance_criteria: Environment Secrets Audit passes for staging.

work_units.title: Run Staging Readiness
work_units.objective: Validate migrations, build, identity isolation and staging contract before deployment.

work_units.title: Manually deploy Cloudflare Staging
work_units.objective: Deploy exact development source through the guarded manual staging workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Queue and DLQ exist and bind correctly.

work_units.title: Certify staging runtime and Shopify acceptance
work_units.objective: Verify health, database, queues, sessions, Admin GraphQL and billing reads.
acceptance_criteria: Signed staging acceptance passes against isolated test shop.

work_units.title: Create and release Staging Shopify version
work_units.objective: Release the exact verified staging Shopify configuration only.
acceptance_criteria: Exact staging candidate created and released.
Local and Production configs remain untouched.

work_units.title: Prepare reviewed production candidate after Staging acceptance
work_units.objective: Allow production preparation only after all Staging acceptance evidence is recorded.
acceptance_criteria: Staging phase is accepted before production preparation starts.
